Name: Rideshare - Become a Mount for Your Friends
Author: daguaochengtang
Description:
Patrick Star Transformation
[b]Transform into Patrick Star and start a completely different life in Stardew Valley![/b]
[quote]⭐ Who needs a normal farmer when you can be Patrick Star?[/quote][line]
[heading]🌟 Overview[/heading]
Have you ever wanted to live in Stardew Valley as [b]Patrick Star[/b]?
[b]Patrick Star Transformation[/b] is a fun character transformation mod that allows your farmer to transform into Patrick Star and explore Pelican Town with a completely different appearance.
This is more than a simple sprite replacement. The mod includes custom character rendering, animations, riding support, and multiplayer functionality designed specifically around Patrick.
Farm, explore, ride around town, and enjoy Stardew Valley with your friends — as Patrick Star.
[line]
[heading]✨ Features[/heading]
⭐ Patrick Star Transformation
Transform your farmer into [b]Patrick Star[/b] while keeping the normal Stardew Valley gameplay experience.
Patrick dynamically follows the player's movement, direction, and current gameplay state.
🎬 Custom Animations
Custom animation and rendering logic has been created specifically for Patrick.
The mod dynamically responds to player movement and different gameplay states instead of simply replacing the original farmer sprite.
🐎 Riding Support
Riding is fully supported while transformed.
Patrick's appearance and animation will adapt according to:
[list]
[*]Player position[/*]
[*]Facing direction[/*]
[*]Movement[/*]
[*]Riding state[/*]
[/list]👥 Multiplayer Support
The mod supports:
[list]
[*]Single-player[/*]
[*]Local multiplayer[/*]
[*]Online multiplayer[/*]
[*]Transformation visibility between players[/*]
[/list]For the best multiplayer experience, [b]all players are recommended to install the same version of the mod[/b].
Multiplayer synchronization is still being improved. On higher-latency online connections, remote player movement or riding animations may occasionally appear slightly delayed.
[line]
[heading]🎮 How to Use[/heading]
Install the mod, launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI, and use the Patrick transformation feature in-game.
Controls and configuration options may evolve as additional features are added. Please check the latest version notes for changes.
[line]
[heading]📦 Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Latest version of Patrick Star Transformation[/*]
[/list]Using the latest stable versions of Stardew Valley and SMAPI is recommended.
[line]
[heading]🔧 Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Download Patrick Star Transformation.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded archive.[/*]
[*]Place the complete mod folder inside:[/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code][list=1]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Example:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── PatrickStarTransformation/
        ├── manifest.json
        ├── PatrickStarTransformation.dll
        └── ...[/code]Do not copy only the DLL file into the Mods folder.
[line]
[heading]👥 Multiplayer[/heading]
For multiplayer sessions, it is strongly recommended that [b]every player installs the same version of the mod[/b].
This helps ensure correct:
[list]
[*]Patrick rendering[/*]
[*]Transformation synchronization[/*]
[*]Animation behavior[/*]
[*]Riding state display[/*]
[*]Multiplayer compatibility[/*]
[/list]If only some players have the mod installed, other clients may not display Patrick correctly.
[line]
[heading]⚠️ Known Issues[/heading]
Multiplayer Riding Latency
During multiplayer sessions, especially over online connections with higher latency, remote players may notice a small delay in riding animations or character positioning.
The amount of delay may depend on:
[list]
[*]Network latency / Ping[/*]
[*]Host connection quality[/*]
[*]Network jitter[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley's multiplayer synchronization behavior[/*]
[/list]Multiplayer synchronization and visual smoothing will continue to be improved in future versions.
Compatibility
Mods that heavily modify the following systems may potentially conflict with Patrick Star Transformation:
[list]
[*]Farmer rendering[/*]
[*]Player animations[/*]
[*]Farmer sprites[/*]
[*]Player movement[/*]
[*]Mount systems[/*]
[*]Horse behavior[/*]
[/list]If you discover a compatibility issue, please report it through the Nexus Mods [b]Posts[/b] or [b]Bugs[/b] section.
[line]
[heading]🐞 Bug Reports[/heading]
When reporting a problem, please include:

[*]Host or Farmhand[/*]
[*]Steps to reproduce[/*]
[*]SMAPI log[/*]
[*]Screenshot or video if possible[/*]
[/list]For multiplayer problems, please also include:
[code]Host / Farmhand
Local Multiplayer / Online Multiplayer
Approximate Ping[/code]Videos are especially useful for animation and synchronization issues.
[line]
[heading]🚧 Development[/heading]
Patrick Star Transformation is still under active development.
Future improvements may include:

🇨🇳 中文说明
[heading]🌟 Mod 简介[/heading]
有没有想过，在星露谷里直接变成[b]派大星[/b]生活？
[b]Patrick Star Transformation（派大星变身 Mod）[/b] 是一个为《星露谷物语》制作的趣味角色变身 Mod。
安装后，玩家可以将自己的角色变成派大星，以全新的形象在鹈鹕镇种地、探索、移动、骑乘以及和朋友一起联机。
这个 Mod 并不是简单替换玩家贴图，而是围绕派大星制作了独立的角色显示、动画、骑乘以及多人同步逻辑。
[quote]⭐ 谁还要当普通农民？直接当派大星。[/quote][line]
[heading]✨ 主要功能[/heading]
⭐ 派大星变身
玩家可以将自己的角色变成派大星，同时保留《星露谷物语》原本的操作和游戏体验。
派大星会根据玩家的位置、移动方向和当前状态动态更新。
🎬 自定义动画
针对派大星制作了独立的动画与显示逻辑，而不是简单替换原版 Farmer Sprite。
🐎 骑乘支持
支持玩家在骑乘状态下使用派大星形象。
骑乘动画会根据：
[list]
[*]玩家位置[/*]
[*]朝向[/*]
[*]移动状态[/*]
[*]骑乘状态[/*]
[/list]进行动态更新。
👥 多人联机
目前支持：
[list]
[*]单人游戏[/*]
[*]本地多人联机[/*]
[*]远程多人联机[/*]
[*]不同玩家之间的变身状态显示[/*]
[/list]为了获得最佳联机体验，[b]建议所有玩家安装相同版本的 Mod[/b]。
多人同步功能仍在持续优化中。
远程联机时，如果网络 Ping 较高，其他玩家看到的骑乘动作或位置可能存在轻微延迟。
